title: NFTokenOffer
key_points: Defines the NFTokenOffer ledger object type.
An NFTokenOffer is a proposal to create a new NFToken on the XRP Ledger.
The owner of an NFToken can update its metadata, including its price and terms, as long as the NFToken has not been sold yet.
The NFTokenOffer object includes fields for the proposed name, URL, and price of the NFToken.
limitations: Scope is limited to the XRP Ledger and its NFTokenOffer feature.
asserts: An NFTokenOffer is a proposal to create a new NFToken on the XRP Ledger, with fields for the proposed name, URL, and price.
